Environment · India

Monsoon Rains Cause Deaths, Displacement, and Disruption Across India

Heavy monsoon rains have led to significant disruptions and fatalities across several Indian states. In Assam, floods have affected tens of thousands, submerging villages and damaging crops. Meanwhile, Mumbai experienced severe waterlogging and a building collapse, resulting in multiple deaths. Himachal Pradesh has also reported rain-related casualties and infrastructure damage.
